assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Ribo-Zero Gold, NextSeq500 38-bp PE) of inguinal WAT (S3.5.p1)
sample_inclusion: male C57BL6/JBomTac mice, iWAT collected immediately (0 h) after 1-h maximal treadmill exercise or sham at ZT3 (early rest) or ZT15 (early active); n = 6 per group, 4 groups, 24 libraries (S3.1.p1, FIG1, S1.2.p1)
primary_estimand: acute exercise (RUN vs sham SED) effect on iWAT gene expression immediately post-exercise, estimated separately at ZT15 (early active) and ZT3 (early rest)
planned_contrasts: RUN vs SED at ZT15 (early active) (S1.2.p1; paper: 121 DEGs, mostly up)
RUN vs SED at ZT3 (early rest) (S1.2.p1; paper: 0 DEGs)
ZT15 vs ZT3 in SED (time-of-day, sedentary) (S1.2.p1; paper: 192 DEGs)
ZT15 vs ZT3 in RUN (time-of-day, exercised) (S1.2.p1; paper: 744 DEGs)
repeated_measure_unit: none (independent animals, one sample per mouse)
normalization: edgeR filterByExpr (min count 10, design by group), TMM/CPM (S3.6.p1)
paper_method: edgeR quasi-likelihood NB GLM, design ~0 + group (4 groups) (S3.6.p1)
paper_results: 121 DEGs RUN vs SED at ZT15, 0 at ZT3; 192 time-of-day DEGs in SED, 744 in RUN; named up genes at ZT15 exercise: Nr4a1, Nr4a3, Vegfa, Adrb2, Cpeb2, Cyp2b10, Pdk4, Slc25a25, Ppargc1a, Ucp1, Dio2, Gadd45g, Irf4, Zfp516, Crem (S1.2.p2, FIG2); GO MF enrichment of DNA-binding transcription activator activity, steroid hormone receptor activity, glucocorticoid receptor binding (S1.2.p2)
